PROVINCIAL MOTOR
VEHICLE

ORDINANCE VI OF 20
An Ordinance
further to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 28th February, 2002]
No.
1egis.1(17)70-II/1139-44/1160, dated 28-2-2002.---The following Ordinance
by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information:
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Provincial Motor
Vehicles (North-West Frontier Province) Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Provincial Motor Vehicles N -W F P Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 46 of W.P. Ord. XIX of 1965

PROVINCIAL MOTOR VEHICLE
PROVINCIAL MOTOR
VEHICLE
(N.-W.F.P.)
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE VI OF 20
An Ordinance
further to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 28th February, 2002]
No.
1egis.1(17)70-II/1139-44/1160, dated 28-2-2002.---The following Ordinance
by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information:
3. Amendment of section 46 of
W.P. Ord. XIX of 1965.--In the said Ordinance, in section 46,--
(A) in subsection (1), for clause
(ii),, including the proviso hereunder, the following be substituted, namely:
"(ii)
a District Transport authority for each District in the province to exercise
and discharge throughout the
District concerned the powers and functions conferred on it by or under this Chapter:
Provided that--
(a) permits for vehicles plying
within the limits of a District shall be issued by the District Transport
Authority concerned;
(b) permits for vehicles plying
within the limits of two adjoining districts shall be issued by the District
Transport Authority of any of the said two adjoining Districts, subject to a
non-objection certificate issued by the District Transport Authority of such
other adjoining District; and
(c) permits for vehicles plying within
the limits of more than two Districts will be issued by Provincial Transport
Authority.";
(B) for subsection (2), except
the. Explanation thereunder, the following shall be substituted, namely:
"(2) The Provincial
Transport Authority or a District Transport Authority shall consist of such
number of official and non-official members as Government may think fit to
appoint, but no person who has any financial interest whether as proprietor,
employee or otherwise in any transport undertaking, except in his
representative character of the proprietors/transporters, shall be appointed or
continue as a member of the Provincial Transport Authority or a District
Transport Authority"; and
(C) in subsection (6), for clause
(ii), the following shall be substituted, namely:
"(ii) to issue permits for
vehicles plying within the limits of more than two districts;".

[Gazette of

No.
1egis.1(17)70-II/1139-44/1160, dated 28-2-2002.---The following Ordinance
by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information:
4. Amendment of section 47 of
W.P. Ord. XIX of 1965.--In the said Ordinance, in section 47, for
subsection (1), the following shall be substituted, namely:
"47. General
provisions as to applications for permits.--Every application for a
permit shall be made to the District Transport Authority of the District
concerned or of one of the Districts in which it is proposed to use the vehicle
or vehicles and, if the applicant resides or has his principal place of
business in anyone of those Districts, to the District Transport Authority of
that District:
Provided that if the permit or
permits applied for is covered by clause (c) of the proviso to subsection (1)
of section 46, the District Transport Authority by when the application is
received shall forward the same to the Provincial Transport Authority for such
action as is deemed fit by the latter Authority. ".
